chapters.label: First game for France
chapters.text: Stuttgart. Rayan Cherki's first game for France, in white. Mbappé passes to him on the edge of the box. He pops it up and smashes a volley. Goal!

chapters.label: Pop and volley
chapters.text: Watch again. One touch lifts the ball up. Then a volley with his left foot, too fast for the keeper.

chapters.label: The cross
chapters.text: Near the end, he is out on the right. He cuts inside onto his left foot and curls a cross. Kolo Muani heads it in!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: practise with both feet, so defenders can't guess which way you will go!
